notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Faeburrow Elder and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
description:
Activate Rex using Faeburrow Elder's ability by tapping it, adding at least {W}{U}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
